node.title: XML Generator ticker=yes only works sporadically? (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
In [id://11116359], I'm using the [id://30175|newest nodes] [id://72241|XML Generator] with the ticker=yes parameter. This seems to prevent the "Last here" time on [id://830549|my profile] from updating most of the time, but not always, and I still see myself in the [id://590099|Other Users Nodelet]. Does anyone happen to know what's up with that?

Update: Hmm, I can currently not reproduce this anymore.
